title: LLP: LLM-Based Product Pricing in E-commerce
abstract: arXiv:2510.09347v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Unlike Business-to-Consumer e-commerce platforms (e.g., Amazon), inexperienced individual sellers on Consumer-to-Consumer platforms (e.g., eBay) often face significant challenges in setting prices for their second-hand products efficiently. Therefore, numerous studies have been proposed for automating price prediction. However, most of them are based on static regression models, which suffer from poor generalization performance and fail to capture market dynamics (e.g., the price of a used iPhone decreases over time). Inspired by recent breakthroughs in Large Language Models (LLMs), we introduce LLP, the first LLM-based generative framework for second-hand product pricing. LLP first retrieves similar products to better align with the dynamic market change. translated_title: LLP：基于大语言模型的电商产品定价
translated_abstract: 与企业对消费者（B2C）电商平台（如亚马逊）不同，消费者对消费者（C2C）平台（如eBay）上缺乏经验的个人卖家在高效为其二手产品定价时常常面临重大挑战。因此，已有大量研究被提出用于自动化价格预测。然而，其中大多数方法基于静态回归模型，这些模型泛化性能较差，且无法捕捉市场动态（例如，二手iPhone的价格会随时间下降）。受大语言模型（LLM）近期突破性进展的启发，我们提出了LLP——首个基于大语言模型的二手产品定价生成式框架。LLP首先检索相似产品，以更好地对齐动态的市场变化。随后，它利用大语言模型对自由文本中关键定价信息的细致理解来生成准确的价格建议。为了增强大语言模型的领域推理能力……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个基于大语言模型的二手产品定价生成式框架LLP，通过检索相似产品捕捉动态市场变化，并利用大语言模型对自由文本的深度理解生成准确的价格建议，克服了传统静态回归模型泛化性差、无法捕捉市场动态的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LLP, the first LLM-based generative framework for second-hand product pricing, which retrieves similar products to capture dynamic market changes and leverages LLMs' nuanced understanding of free-form text to generate accurate price suggestions, overcoming the poor generalization and static nature of traditional regression models.
